subject: Activation: additional app pods & renewal addendum — provisioning schedule
messages:
From: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@valencehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Reyes <samantha@valencehealth.com>, procurement@valencehealth.com
Date: 2026-04-18 09:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request — new apps and keys

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our product team is ready to spin up three new app projects that will call the Redwood API: ClaimsAssist, IntakeForms, and CareChat. We expect initial traffic for ClaimsAssist to be highest (bursting during EOD batch windows).

Before we move forward: can you confirm how new API keys are provisioned, how we should name them to map back to our billing/teams, and whether there's any required contract amendment for the extra capacity? We also want short-term burst capacity for the first 6 weeks.

--Tom
Senior Product Manager, Valence Health
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@valencehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-18 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request — new apps and keys

Tom — great to hear the team is ready. Short answers up front: yes, we can provision per-project API keys (namespaced), we support burst capacity for an initial ramp window, and we should add a short amendment to your renewal to formalize the committed units and pricing tier for the new projects.

I'll detail the operational plan below and attach a provisioning matrix. Key points: 
- Key naming: recommended pattern valence.<project>.<env> (e.g., valence.claimsassist.prod). We’ll emit both a long-lived credential and a scoped service key for each app.
- Rate limits & billing: default tier covers baseline; we propose a 25% committed uplift for the first 3 months for burst protection, then reassess.
- Provisioning timeline: keys and sandbox access: 48 business hours after PO/DocuSign. Prod keys + routing + canary policy: 5 business days.

Laura — can you confirm the amendment language and pricing delta? Ben/Monica — can you prep the keys and a canary rollout playbook (including revocation steps)?

Thanks,
Aditya
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Tom Briggs <t.briggs@valencehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@valencehealth.com
Date: 2026-04-19 08:22 -0700
Subject: RE: Expansion request — new apps and keys

Tom — thanks. Draft amendment attached (proposed-amendment-v1.pdf) that: 1) adds three named projects, 2) increases committed token units by 25% for 90 days with an option to convert to a permanent tier at the next renewal, and 3) includes a one-time credit for migration costs.

High-level items for you to review:
- Effective date for amendment: start of the next billing cycle after signed.
- Temporary burst windows: we’ll mark ClaimsAssist with a burst SLA of +30% for up to 6 weeks; we’ll monitor via the Console.
- Key governance: we’ll provision keys in a namespaced folder and provide a mapping CSV for your finance team.

Procurement — please confirm DocuSign recipient list and if you require any additional PO fields.

Laura
Senior Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tom Briggs <t.briggs@valencehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-21 13:09 -0700
Subject: RE: Expansion request — new apps and keys

Tom / team — attaching the provisioning matrix (valence-provisioning-matrix.xlsx) and a short key-naming guidelines file. Operational notes: 
- We will create four keys per project (sandbox, staging-canary, prod-primary, prod-fallback).
- Naming convention enforced on our console: valence.<project>.<env>.<role> (role=svc or app).
- Canary rollout plan: start at 2% traffic, 10% after 48 hours if error rate <0.5%, full after 5 days.
- Revocation: immediate rotation endpoint available; we recommend a retention policy of 30 days for old keys.

Monica will create the sandbox keys once DocuSign returns. If you want earlier access, we can issue time-limited sandbox keys today (staging only).

—Ben
Solutions Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Reyes <samantha@valencehealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Briggs <t.briggs@valencehealth.com>, procurement@valencehealth.com
Date: 2026-04-23 16:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion request — new apps and keys

Thanks everyone — procurement has signed off on the amendment and we've completed DocuSign (link: https://www.docusign.net/transaction/12345ABC). We accept the 90-day uplift and the one-time migration credit.

Two quick asks before you provision: 
1) Can you include a mapping CSV that contains key name, project owner email, and internal cost center for our finance system?
2) For ClaimsAssist bursts, can you add a temporary rate-limit override that is only active in the EOD window (22:00–02:00 PT) for the first 6 weeks?

If you can confirm both, we'll trigger the PO this afternoon.

—Samantha
Director of Product Operations, Valence Health
